title: Every unresolved outcome retains the reservation, whatever its cause
description: T-011 and T-012 in one table. A transmission that never completed, a cross-origin redirect refused after the signature had already reached the merchant, and a 5xx are three different causes with one money disposition: the outcome is unknown, so the reservation is held to its TTL. Each reports a distinct causeCategory so a caller can tell them apart without any of them changing what happens to the money. The redirect case is the one that changed at S15b: its money disposition is unchanged, but its public error code is TX402_REDIRECT_BLOCKED, because SPEC §6.1 names that error for a cross-origin redirect and the high-level client was reporting a generic ambiguity instead (O52). Kind and errorCode are separate fields precisely so one can move without the other. All three are given attempt 1 of 3 deliberately: an unresolved outcome does not consume the remaining attempts, it ends the loop, because retrying could pay twice.
